summary: Tested Tender Criteria Builder stage 1 end to end (backend pytest plus admin and vendor UI) and the Google OAuth gating. What works: save, validation and lock; the publish 409 gate on POST /publish; the public view is 404 for drafts; AI read (6 criteria in about 6s); templates and blank rows; the locked read-only modal; the vendor bid-criteria section with answers and proof uploads; the submit label gating; the 422 for missing answers; answers sealed in the DB and redacted for admin. Google button hidden, config {enabled:false}, start returns 503. Found 2 real bugs: (1) the must-pass publish gate can be bypassed through PATCH /notices/{ref} with is_published:true and through POST /notices with is_published:true (the 'Publish immediately' checkbox); (2) a criterion with 'Proof mandatory' ticked but empty proof text (the default for '+ Blank criterion') shows no upload control on the bid page, so suppliers can never submit.

critical.issue: Publishes a draft with no criteria at all. Got 200 and is_published=True. Only POST /{ref}/publish checks has_must_pass. Reproduced by test_v72 TestC.

A new notice created with 'Publish immediately' goes live with tender_criteria=None (got 200, published True). This is the NoticesPanel checkbox data-testid=notice-publish. It breaks the rule that every new tender needs at least one must-pass criterion.

Accepts proof_required=true with an empty proof text. BidCriteriaSection only shows the upload control when c.proof is set, while criteriaReady and clean_answers still require a proof. Suppliers are blocked forever ('Answer all tender criteria to submit'). Reproduced in the UI on TEST-CRIT-001 (the 'Methodology' blank row). The BLANK template defaults to proof_required:true with proof:'', and the AI can return the same combination.

minor.endpoint: payments_extra hosting_fee paid / vendor_tenders approve / tender_templates publish
minor.issue: These also set is_published=True without the must-pass check. Decide whether the 'every new tender' rule applies to them.
Does not check is_published (the vendor endpoint works on drafts). Low risk.
Pydantic detail reaches the UI as 'Something went wrong · HTTP 422 / Value error, ...'. Strip the 'Value error, ' prefix and use a friendlier heading.

ui_bugs.issue: No upload control when proof_required is set but the proof text is empty, so the supplier is stuck

integration_issues.issue: Goes live without criteria (backend does not gate it). Either gate it in the backend or disable the checkbox until criteria exist.

issues: The auto-fill select (crit-prefill-i) is col-span-1, so labels are cut to 'Annu'/'No au'
The locked view does not show that proof is mandatory when the proof text is empty
Validation errors do not point to the row (only the title in the toast)
Criterion proof files are listed as 'TECHNICAL · proofX.pdf', looking like envelope documents, with no label for the criterion they belong to

action_items: Apply the has_must_pass check in update_notice (PATCH) and create_notice when is_published is true. Return 409 with the same message.

Either require non-empty proof text when proof_required is true (CriterionIn validator, with BLANK defaulting proof_required:false), or always render the upload control when proof_required is true. Also normalise AI output the same way.
Optional: widen crit-prefill select; label criterion proofs in the bid docs list; clean the 422 message prefix.
critical_code_review_comments: notices.py update_notice and create_notice skip the criteria gate (only publish_notice has it).
tender_criteria.CriterionIn: no check that proof_required implies proof text, and BLANK on the frontend creates exactly this invalid state.
Criteria lock depends only on is_published. An admin can PATCH is_published:false to unlock and edit the criteria of a live tender without a corrigendum.
clean_answers accepts a 'No' for must-pass yes/no (fine for stage 1; stage 2 must fail it).

success_rate.frontend: 85% (all requested flows pass; empty-proof blocking bug)

seed_data_creation: TEST-CRIT-001 (seeded by main agent) was missing tenant_id, so it was not listed in /admin/e/notices. Set tenant_id=PMC-KZ-01, kyc_bypass, emd 0 to test it. Published it via UI, submitted bid PMC-BID-2026-00090 as northfield. Everything was deleted afterwards (notice, bid, 12 uploads). No DEMO records touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_v72_tender_criteria.py -n0 -v. It must run with -n0 because the classes share module state. TestC fails until the PATCH gate is added. Admin UI login: /login, then signin-role-admin. Notices list filters by tenant_id, so seeded notices need tenant_id PMC-KZ-01. Do not remove sonner toasts via DOM in Playwright (it crashes React).
